svg.title: Atmosphere dataclass architecture, Day 5 target state
svg.desc: Three retrieval dataclasses on the left feed into StageData container. MapillaryImage (after Day 5 merge) feeds via Camera into the WorldMirror prior bundle.
svg.text: Each fetcher returns its own dataclass list, all in shared ENU frame
StageData (mutable container, filled by each Stage in sequence)
mapillary_to_camera(img) reads graph-api fields, produces c2w camera in ENU
